events.round_label: Reverse merger private placement (PIPE), Initial Closing

notes: Reverse merger into Unite Acquisition 2 Corp. (a Form 10 shell, not a SPAC) with simultaneous PIPE, closed 2026-09-04 per the 8-K. The 8-K evidences $25,032,287.50 for the Initial Closing of the Offering (910,265 units at $27.50); more closings may follow ("Initial Closing"). The census lists 62,852,415 (disclosed) for the same 8-K URL, but that figure was not found in the 8-K text in this pass: do not use it until reconciled. No pre-merger private rounds were evidenced (WebSearch budget exhausted); the company site mentions a DOE INFUSE project award (no amount). Placement agent Laidlaw & Company (UK) Ltd. is a fee-earning agent, not recorded as a participant. Investor names in the PIPE are not given in the 8-K text searched.
